audience: accountants and bookkeepers who manage client files in AdminPulse

useCases.title: Find tasks with a deadline in a week
useCases.text: List the tasks with a deadline in a date range. Open one task to read its status, deadline and relation.

useCases.title: Check the invoices of a client
useCases.text: Find the client by name. List its sales invoices, filtered by paid status, and open one to read its lines and payment status.

useCases.title: Log a call or meeting on a client file
useCases.text: Find the client and log the call, meeting or note with its date and time. List the interactions afterwards to check the entry.

useCases.title: Create a follow-up task for a client
useCases.text: Find the client, then create a task with a deadline. Update the task status when the work is done.

useCases.title: Review the documents stored for a client
useCases.text: List the document metadata of a client, such as name, type, date and tags. The server does not upload documents.
